title: Malta Year 8 Math Chapter 6 — Percentages Practice
question: 30 percentage questions: 10 Easy, 10 Medium, 10 Hard.
intro:
**Three levels:**

- Easy: percent, fraction, decimal and the quick percentages
- Medium: build from 10%, 5% and 1%; a score as a percentage
- Hard: sale prices, VAT, rises and falls

- **Answers:** type the number only (no € or % sign).
- A fraction goes in two boxes, in its simplest form.

questions.title: Percent to decimal
questions.prompt: Write \(30\%\) as a decimal.

questions.title: Decimal to percent
questions.prompt:
Write \(0.45\) as a percentage.

Type the number only.
questions.solution:
\[0.45\times100 = \boxed{45}\%\]

\(4.5\) moves the digits only one place.

questions.title: Fraction to percent
questions.prompt:
Write \(\dfrac{3}{4}\) as a percentage.

Type the number only.
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} \frac{3}{4} &= \frac{75}{100} \\ &= \boxed{75}\% \end{aligned}\]

\(34\) just joins the digits; make the bottom 100.

questions.title: Percent to fraction
questions.prompt: Write \(40\%\) as a fraction in its simplest form.
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} 40\% &= \frac{40}{100} \\ &= \boxed{\frac{2}{5}} \end{aligned}\]

\(\dfrac{40}{100}\) is right but not simplest: divide top and bottom by 20.

questions.title: Ten per cent
questions.prompt:
Find \(10\%\) of €90.

Type the number of euros.

questions.title: Three quarters
questions.prompt: Find \(75\%\) of 20 pastizzi.

questions.title: Fifteen per cent
questions.prompt:
Find \(15\%\) of €60.

Type the number of euros.

questions.title: Forty-five per cent
questions.prompt:
Find \(45\%\) of €20.

Type the number of euros.

questions.title: Test score
questions.prompt:
You get 18 out of 20 in a test.

What percentage is that?

Type the number only.
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} \frac{18}{20} &= \frac{90}{100} \\ &= \boxed{90}\% \end{aligned}\]

\(18\%\) forgets that the whole is 20, not 100.

questions.title: Out of 25
questions.prompt:
14 out of 25 students take the bus.

What percentage is that?

Type the number only.
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} \frac{14}{25} &= \frac{56}{100} \\ &= \boxed{56}\% \end{aligned}\]

\(\times4\) top and bottom makes the bottom 100.

questions.title: Out of 12
questions.prompt:
9 out of 12 boats in the harbour are luzzi.

What percentage is that?

Type the number only.

questions.title: Bus seats
questions.prompt:
A bus has 40 seats and 32 are taken.

What percentage is taken?

Type the number only.

questions.title: Jacket sale
questions.prompt:
A jacket costs €80.

The sale takes \(25\%\) off.

What is the sale price in euros?
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} 25\% \text{ of } 80 &= 20 \\ 80 - 20 &= \boxed{60} \end{aligned}\]

\(20\) is the money off, not the new price.

questions.title: VAT
questions.prompt:
A pair of trainers costs €50 before VAT.

VAT is \(18\%\).

What is the price with VAT, in euros?
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} 10\% &= 5 \\ 8\% &= 4 \\ 18\% &= 9 \\ 50 + 9 &= \boxed{59} \end{aligned}\]

\(9\) is only the VAT; add it on.

questions.title: Bike sale
questions.prompt:
A bike costs €120 and is \(15\%\) off.

What is the sale price in euros?
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} 10\% &= 12 \\ 5\% &= 6 \\ 15\% &= 18 \\ 120 - 18 &= \boxed{102} \end{aligned}\]

\(138\) adds the \(15\%\) on instead of taking it off.

questions.title: Rent rise
questions.prompt:
Rent is €600 a month.

It rises by \(5\%\).

What is the new rent in euros?

questions.title: Festa crowd
questions.prompt:
250 people came to a festa last year.

This year \(20\%\) more came.

How many came this year?

questions.title: Phone sale
questions.prompt:
A phone costs €240 and is \(30\%\) off.

What is the sale price in euros?

questions.title: Tip
questions.prompt:
A meal costs €30.

You leave a \(10\%\) tip.

How much do you pay in total, in euros?

questions.title: Shoe sale
questions.prompt:
Shoes cost €45 and are \(20\%\) off.

What is the sale price in euros?

questions.title: Village
questions.prompt:
A village has 800 people.

The number falls by \(5\%\).

How many people live there now?

questions.title: Multiplier
questions.prompt:
A ferry ticket costs €64.

The price goes up by \(25\%\).

Use \(\times1.25\) to find the new price in euros.
questions.solution:
\[64\times1.25 = \boxed{80}\]

\(64\times0.25 = 16\) is only the rise; \(\times1.25\) gives the new price.

takeaway:
- Per cent means out of 100.
- 10%: divide by 10. 5% is half of 10%. 1%: divide by 100.
- Sale: take the percentage off. VAT or a rise: add it on.
